newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Universe suspended after price surge.
newsitem.headline: Universe suspended after price surge.

text.p: Trading in Shenzhen Universe Industrial Stock Co Ltd's A shares was suspended on Tuesday morning, Shenzhen bourse said in a notice.

Universe's shares rose 2.11 yuan, or 32.61 percent, on Monday to close at 8.58 yuan per share on trade of 17 million shares on rumours that it had sold a Shenzhen property development project to a Hong Kong company.
The company denied the rumours. In a statement published in the official Securities Times, Universe said the rumours were untrue and misleading to investors.

A spokesman for Universe told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin that the company had not yet decided whether or not to sell the property concerned, a project called Qiaoguang Plaza.
He said construction of the property had not yet begun. He gave no further details.
Universal is engaged in real estate development and building materials production.
